name: Test how far a named case can support a wider claim

uses.action: Lay the learner’s pencil beside the teacher’s different apprenticeship. Leave a line for a second account, or print a comparison question that another historian could test.
After comparing an anonymous silhouette with a dated view, give the programme a claim about one learner or leave a second frame for another crew’s account. See how the audience can use that choice.

name: Replace a generic picture with a situated object

uses.action: Fit a second stock cutout to the same silhouette, then expose the launch at Kualoa/Hakipuʻu or the separately dated voyages on that canoe. The selected slide remains on view.
